messages:
cheng: FYI nightly eval flagged regression on quantized-1.3 prompt_suite — small but consistent mismatch on translation prompts.
lia: saw it. failing 23/100 cases with exact-match diffs, but logits look similar.
noah: attaching sample diff:
```
expected: "Bonjour, comment ça va ?"
actual:   "Bonjour, comment ca va ?"
levenshtein=1
```
dylan: punctuation/accents stripped? tokenizer differences?
lia: tokenizer unchanged, same tokenizers in image. runs reproduced only on nightly infra.
nightly-bot: nightly-evals/quantized-1.3 finished 2025-10-08 05:32:08 UTC — 23 regressions (alert sent)
cheng: I ran deterministic seed locally on my dev A100 and couldn't reproduce. suspect nondet at kernel / reduction ordering.
noah: quick root cause note: observed fp32 accumulation order flip during block-level reduction (batch>1) on our cuBLAS-based fused-softmax path. tiny fp differences cause different top-token picks for accents.
lia: do we have logs or a minimal repro?
noah: pasted minimal reproducer below, shows nondet across runs on nightly node (two runs differ at token 12):
```python
# repro snippet (numpy + simple softmax accumulation)
import torch
for _ in range(2):
    x = torch.randn(8, 512, device='cuda', dtype=torch.float32)
    logits = x.matmul(torch.randn(512, 50257, device='cuda', dtype=torch.float32))
    probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)
    top = probs.argmax(dim=-1)
    print(top[0,11].item())
```
noah: run1=1234 run2=1233 -> token difference maps to accent/no-accent variant.
dylan: short-term: we can relax harness exact-match for this prompt set (normalize diacritics) or use tolerant metric. long-term: force deterministic cuBLAS or change accumulation (Kahan / pairwise).
cheng: agree: do both. kernel determinism + harness fallback. Lia, can you open the PRs?
lia: will do. plan: (1) set CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG in Dockerfile for deterministic algs, (2) add nightly unit with batch>1 and random shuffle to catch reorder nondet, (3) update prompt-suite matcher to normalize diacritics and run BLEU fallback.
dylan: also add a debugging flag in harness to dump raw logits for failing cases. helps triage.
noah: created issue #2938 for fused-softmax nondet and linked PR. tagged @sre for infra reproducibility.
sre-bot: noted. scheduling reproducible CI job on dedicated A100 pool and pinning CUDA/cuBLAS versions.
cheng: great. once PRs land let's re-run the nightly against the same image and close the alert. :thumbsup:
lia: PRs opened: r/3456 (docker), r/3457 (harness matcher), r/3458 (unit). I'll follow up with CI links.
cheng: thanks all.
